question: What worship sequence should precede and culminate in the bali offering?
premises: Worship is performed with fragrance, flowers, and similar items.
The ritual proceeds in the same manner.
The sequence culminates in the bali offering.
inference: One should worship with fragrance, flowers, and so forth, continuing up to the bali offering.
plain_english: Having worshipped with fragrance, flowers, and so forth, one should proceed likewise up to the bali offering.
